FN-QBDC544-1
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 299
Committee: County & Municipal Government Sponsor: Senator Bobby Singleton
Analyst: Peter Grogan Date: 04/09/2024
Senate Bill 299 as introduced could increase the obligations of legislative branch entities, by an
undetermined amount dependent upon the costs to: (1) provide for staff during training and
while the Legislature is in legislative session; (2) recognizing achievements of staff; (3)
commemorate persons recognized by the Legislature; and (4) reimburse certain employees for
expenses personally paid by the employee that are directly related to the employee’s position, in
an amount not to exceed $500.

FN-QBDC544-2
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 299
Committee: State Government Sponsor: Senator Bobby Singleton
Analyst: Peter Grogan Date: 04/23/2024
Senate Bill 299 as passed the Senate could increase the obligations of state and legislative
entities by an undetermined amount dependent upon the costs to: (1) provide promotional and
recognition items for certain individuals; and (2) purchase employees meals under certain
circumstances during training and extended work sessions as permitted by this bill..
